author: SickProdigy
description: Create server events with portable calendar exports and Google Calendar links.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores server event details and the Discord user ID of each event creator. Event creators may remove their own events; administrators may remove any server event.
install_msg: Use [p]help calendar to create server events and export them without granting the bot calendar-account access.
name: CalendarEvents
short: Portable server events and calendar exports.
